1722-2034-3583-6794.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6794.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

539-3821-4679-5686-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-5686-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 2.

619-2645-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-2645-3430-5475.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6723-7297.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-5078-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-6578--52.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6578--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-728-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-3899.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-3899.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3641-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-7173-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.

1981-2415-7173-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

997-2738-4871-5687.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2043-5231-5446-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
2043-5231-5446-7824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

1086-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2452-3249-5173-5686.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

439-4452-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power, which will cause you to mill Arashin Sovereign.
As Arashin Sovereign is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2724-4006-7309.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Don & Leo. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-5544-6462.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4365-5086-5183-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4365-5086-5183-5231-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1987-4823-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-4823-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Timeless Witness.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-4853-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
1183-4853-5527.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4853-5527.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

4905-5220-6634-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1127-3152-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

647-1563-2457-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

413-3394-6249--5.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.

413-3394-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2060-2092-4565-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-4565-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

372-695-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-4823.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1469-1558-5471.notablePrerequisites:
Obeka has power 4 or greater and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You are the monarch.
1469-1558-5471.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, creating a token copy of Time Sieve.
Deal combat damage using Obeka.
Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least four upkeep steps after this phase.
Repeat step 1 during each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate the nontoken Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Time Sieve tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1144-3510-5158.description:
Yavimaya causes all lands to be Forests in addition to their other types, thus Life and Limb causes all lands to be 1/1 Saproling creatures.
Because Elesh Norn gives all creatures your opponents control -2/-2, they die as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.
Whenever an opponent plays a land, it will also die as a state-based action.

Helm of the Ghastlord attached to Niv-Mizzet.

384-2353.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.

23-776-1237-1329.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Fountain of Youth to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Fountain of Youth.
Cast Fountain of Youth.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

901-2024-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
901-2024-5168.description:
During your upkeep, activate Govern the Guildless by paying {1}{U} and revealing it from your hand, making a creature you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
